D5/S3/Quantum/Divergence/GibbsVariationa.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Divergence.GibbsVariationalIdentity.gibbs_variational_identity
D5/S3/Quantum/Divergence/GibbsVariationa.signature: theorem gibbs_variational_identity (H : CStarMatrix n n ℂ) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) (rho : DensityState n) : Real.log (partitionFunction H) = (Matrix.trace (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm (H * rho.1))).re + vonNeumannEntropy rho + quantumRelativeEntropy rho (gibbsState H hH)
